title: Use thru Bedrock throws blocking errors due to citations
body:
I am not sure exactly what triggers this, but after using for a bit, I will get an error like: 

`  ⎿  API Error: messages.3.content.0.text.citations: Extra inputs are not permitted`

After that error, no further conversation is possible until closing and restarting the client.  I will update if I can determine what triggers the error specifically.
author: jeremycyr-MK
